name: Delivered!

pick.label: Pick a delivery
pick.heading: Pick something and deliver it, whatever it takes
lead: Every delivery is a tiny supply chain: something has to get from A to B, on time and in one piece, while the bridge is closed and the S-Bahn isn’t running.
Choose something to deliver and invent the service that gets it there. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *The more awkward the better.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Obviously I am not looking for a real business plan here, this is just for a bit of fun. Some of these services already exist in Berlin, and some really shouldn’t.

shelf.head: Food and drink
items: Fresh bread rolls on a Sunday

shelf.head: Big and awkward
items: A sofa up five flights of stairs

shelf.head: Emergencies
items: A phone charger at a festival
An umbrella in a sudden storm
A tie for a job interview
The concert tickets you left at home

shelf.head: Slightly mad
items: A live DJ for your party
A goat to mow your lawn
A choir to sing at your door

rows: Something short and catchy that people will remember.
Cargo bike, drone, a boat on the Spree, a very fit student…?
How fast? What’s guaranteed? What happens if you’re late?
The road’s closed, the driver’s ill, it’s raining sideways. What now?
Who do you get to talk about it, and where?

values.thing: A sofa up five flights of stairs
values.name: Sofa So Good
values.how: Two very strong philosophy students and a cargo bike with a trailer. They discuss Nietzsche on the way up the stairs, which takes their minds off the pain.
values.promise: Your sofa arrives within 48 hours, with no new scratches on the stairwell. If it’s late, you get the sofa for free. (This is why we will go bankrupt.)
values.planb: If the stairwell is too narrow, the sofa goes up the outside of the building on ropes, and the whole street comes out to watch.
values.promote: Filming every delivery for TikTok. A sofa stuck on a staircase is the most relatable content on the internet.
